# Scope

This vignette is a short, reproducible research checklist for SigBenchR 0.4.0.
It uses the packaged melanoma ICI cohorts (`datasets_ici`) and demo signatures.
Results are **exploratory**: AUC measures discrimination, not calibrated clinical
prediction. With only four heterogeneous cohorts, meta-analytic summaries
(including logit-AUC REML + truncated HKSJ) remain exploratory.

```{r libs}
library(SigBenchR)
data(datasets_ici, package = "SigBenchR")
data(signatures_demo, package = "SigBenchR")
```

# Benchmark across scoring methods

Run a fast discrimination screen with `mean`, `zscore`, and single-sample
`ss_rank` (no PR bootstrap, no null permutations).

```{r bench}
res <- suppressWarnings(run_benchmark(
  signatures = signatures_demo,
  datasets = datasets_ici,
  methods = c("mean", "zscore", "ss_rank"),
  compute_pr = FALSE,
  compute_null = FALSE,
  seed = 42L
))
head(res[, c("dataset", "signature", "method", "n", "auc", "independent")])
```

# Independence: Cytokine-5 vs IFNG6

`Cytokine-5` lists the packaged ICI cohorts in `derived_from`, so
`independent = FALSE` and it is excluded from the default independent summary.
`IFNG6` uses `derived_from = character(0)` and remains eligible.

```{r indep}
table(res$signature, res$independent, useNA = "ifany")
sm_indep <- suppressWarnings(summarize_auc(res, method = "mean"))
sm_indep[, c("signature", "n_cohorts", "auc_n_weighted", "auc_re", "tau2_reml")]
```

# SD spectrum bias: exclude vs ORR vs DCR

Stable disease coding can shift the responder definition (ORR vs DCR).
`check_sd_sensitivity()` re-runs the same settings under `"exclude"`, `"as_0"`,
and `"as_1"`. The delta threshold is arbitrary.

```{r sd-sens}
sd_tab <- suppressWarnings(check_sd_sensitivity(
  signatures = signatures_demo["IFNG6"],
  datasets = datasets_ici[c("riaz_2017", "gide_2019")],
  methods = "mean",
  seed = 42L
))
sd_tab[, c(
  "dataset", "n_exclude", "n_as_0", "n_as_1",
  "auc_exclude", "auc_as_0", "auc_as_1",
  "delta_orr", "delta_dcr", "sd_sensitive"
)]
```

# Stratified REML + HKSJ summary

Pool only within clinically comparable strata. Anti-CTLA4 clinical-benefit labels
(`van_allen_2015`) are not interchangeable with anti-PD1 RECIST cohorts.

```{r strat}
sm_strat <- suppressWarnings(summarize_auc(
  res,
  method = "mean",
  stratify_by = c("treatment", "endpoint_type")
))
sm_strat[, c(
  "signature", "treatment", "endpoint_type", "n_cohorts",
  "auc_n_weighted", "auc_ivw", "auc_re",
  "auc_re_ci_low", "auc_re_ci_high", "tau2_reml", "i2_logit"
)]
```

`auc_re` is the inverse-logit REML estimate; the confidence interval uses a
truncated Hartung-Knapp-Sidik-Jonkman standard error on the logit scale.
With few cohorts the interval is exploratory.

# Load your own full-gene cohort (template)

```{r user-load, eval = FALSE}
# CSV / TSV local files
ds <- read_user_dataset(
  expr_path = "path/to/expression.csv",
  meta_path = "path/to/sample_meta.csv",
  genes_in_rows = TRUE,
  normalization = "TPM",
  scale = "linear"
)

# Or a local named-list RDS bundle (optional MD5 check; no network)
bundle <- load_cohort_bundle(
  path = "path/to/cohort_bundle.rds",
  expected_md5 = NULL
)
```
